title: MC Sooty Edition
description: MSE is RPG-like modpack. Overworld is all burnt, mobs are very strong, but you are not. Become stronger, and leave this forsaken place.
body:
![Modpack Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7b9a6f476b59c6f737d6ebd939953704cfe13a2.png) ![Modpack Description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5befbad603b11f3d594508971661c0f14274fbef.png) # > 𝚆𝙷𝙰𝚃 𝙸𝚂 𝙸𝚃 ? _It's RPG-like modpack that sets in the Burnt Overworld. You start weak, and need to get stronger in a way to beat this modpack. Player's main goal is create a portal that leads in Overworld. Explore dungeons, defeat any enemy that will be on your path, create new machines and powerful gear._ **GET STRONGER. DEFEAT POWERFUL ENEMIES. GET POWERFUL WEAPONS.** # > 𝙵𝙴𝙰𝚃𝚄𝚁𝙴𝚂 - ↳ Unfairly More Challenging Survival - ↳ Quests - ↳ QoL Features - ↳ 250+ Mods - ↳ A Lot Of New Custom Content: - ↳ Custom Artifacts - ↳ Custom Blocks - ↳ Custom Items - ↳ Custom Mechanics - ↳ Custom Biomes - ↳ Custom Mobs and Bosses # > 𝚄𝙿𝙳𝙰𝚃𝙴𝚂 𝚁𝙾𝙰𝙳𝙼𝙰𝙿 - ↳ Initial Release [v1.1.2] ✓ - ↳ Re-searching p.1 [v1.2.0] ✓ - ↳ Visuals Overhaul [v1.3.0] - ↳ Terminal Overhaul [v1.4.0] - ↳ Re-searching p.2 [v1.5.0] - ↳ Final Boss [v1.6.0] - ↳ Burnt Overworld Expansion [v1.7.0] # > 𝙲𝚁𝙴𝙳𝙸𝚃𝚂 ### ↳ 𝚁𝙴𝚂𝙾𝚄𝚁𝙲𝙴𝙿𝙰𝙲𝙺𝚂 - ↳ [Tom's Metal Storage](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/toms-metal-storage) - ↳ [Enhanced Visual Pixelated](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/enhancedvisual-pixelated) - ↳ [Fresh Moves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tras-fresh-player) ### ↳ 𝙼𝙾𝙳𝚂 - ↳ [Ignite HUD](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ignitehud) # > 𝙽𝙾𝚃𝙴𝚂 - ↳ This modpack currently in _alpha_ state! There is a lot of unpolished and unreleased things that are planned to be in future updates.
- ↳ MSE is developed only by 1 person in his freetime. Please be patient if you waiting for an update! - ↳ **All included mods and resourcepacks belong to their respective authors and licenses** ![Terminal Big Belly](https://media.tenor.com/ZeEDoM6EEaoAAAAi/big-belly.gif)
